_comment: Experimental biophysics datasets supervising PANGEA channels. Every URL was verified to resolve before being recorded. Where the plan's description of a resource turned out to be wrong, the correction is stated in the 'plan_correction' field rather than silently followed.

datasets.name: loopseq
datasets.title: loop-seq intrinsic cyclizability
datasets.citation: Basu A, Bobrovnikov DG, Qureshi Z, Kayikcioglu T, Ngo TTM, Ranjan A, Eustermann S, Cieza B, Morgan MT, Hejna M, Rube HT, Hopfner K-P, Wolberger C, Song JS, Ha T. Measuring DNA mechanics on the genome scale. Nature 589:462-467 (2021). doi:10.1038/s41586-020-03052-3
datasets.license: Not open access. Springer Nature TDM terms; the Data Availability statement says there are no restrictions on data availability. Analyse freely; redistribution not explicitly granted.
datasets.plan_correction: There is NO GEO series for loop-seq. The tables are Nature Supplementary Datasets. Raw reads are SRA PRJNA667271 only.
datasets.element_note: 25 bp adapter TTTCTTCACTTATCTCCCACCGTCC + 50 bp variable + 25 bp adapter GGCAGAAGACAAGGGAACGAAATAG; take characters 26-75 for the variable region
datasets.columns: Sequence #, Sequence, Cyclizability (n=26), Cyclizability (n=29), Cyclizability (n=31), C0, Amplitude, Phase
datasets.target_note: C0 is intrinsic cyclizability; n=26/29/31 are raw per-tether measurements and Amplitude/Phase describe the tether-geometry sinusoid removed to obtain C0

datasets.name: orchid
datasets.title: ORChID hydroxyl radical cleavage
datasets.citation: Greenbaum JA, Pang B, Tullius TD. Genome Res 17:947-953 (2007). doi:10.1101/gr.6073107; Bishop EP et al., ACS Chem Biol 6:1314-1320 (2011)
datasets.license: Site states only (c) 2003 Boston University; no license file. UCSC files under the ENCODE Data Release Policy, unrestricted since 2010-10-24.
datasets.plan_correction: PLAN.md states ORChID provides 'experimental hydroxyl radical cleavage for all 512 pentamers'. That is wrong on two counts. ORChID is a sliding TETRAMER model: a measured 256-tetramer table plus a 64-trimer table, with pentamers derived at run time (and there are 1024 pentamers, not 512). The 512-pentamer table is DNAshape's minor-groove-width table, a different resource. Also orchid.bu.edu is dead; the live host is dna.bu.edu/orchid.
datasets.data_note: Lookup tables are embedded as literal data inside PredictCleavagePatterns2.pm in the server tarball. The genome map is a UCSC hg17 wiggle track requiring both the index table and the binary .wib; decode as value = lowerLimit + byte/127*dataRange, with 128 meaning no data. 29,948,050 single-nucleotide values, matching the paper's ~30 Mb.
datasets.channel_family: G. Solvation, hydration and chemical reactivity

datasets.name: array_melt
datasets.title: Array Melt high-throughput DNA melt thermodynamics
datasets.citation: Ke Y, Sharma E, Wayment-Steele HK, Becker WR, Ho A, Marklund E, Greenleaf WJ. High-throughput DNA melt measurements enable improved models of DNA folding thermodynamics. Nat Commun 16:5572 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41467-025-60455-4
datasets.license: Article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the Zenodo DATA is CC BY 4.0
datasets.plan_correction: Second author is Eesha Sharma, not D. Sharma.
datasets.columns: SEQID, dH, dS, Tm, dG_37, dH_se, Tm_se, dG_37_se, dS_se, RefSeq, TargetStruct, Series; RefSeq is the DNA sequence, TargetStruct is dot-bracket
datasets.units: dH kcal/mol, dS kcal/(mol K), dG_37 kcal/mol, Tm degrees C; dG_37 = dH - 310.15*dS and Tm = dH/dS - 273.15 both hold exactly
datasets.known_bug: In arr_v1_1M_n=27732.csv the dS column stores dH/Tm in Celsius rather than Kelvin on all rows. The adjusted and raw v1 files used here are unaffected.

datasets.name: g4seq
datasets.title: G4-seq genome-wide G-quadruplex maps
datasets.citation: Marsico G et al., Nucleic Acids Res 47:3862-3874 (2019). doi:10.1093/nar/gkz179; Chambers VS et al., Nat Biotechnol 33:877-881 (2015). doi:10.1038/nbt.3295
datasets.license: No per-dataset license statement in either GEO record.
datasets.genome_build: hg19 for both studies, confirmed empirically from maximum chr1 coordinate
datasets.data_note: 4-column BED: chrom, start (0-based), end, score. Score is the per-base mismatch percentage maximised over a 50 bp window; floor 25 for K+ and 35 for PDS. GSE63874 files are 3-column with no score. Strand convention is inverted: 'plus' means the hit aligns to the forward strand, so the quadruplex is on the reverse strand.
datasets.ionic_conditions: GSE110582 is Li+ to K+, or PDS with K+. GSE63874 is Na+ to K+, or PDS with Na+.

datasets.name: nucleosome_invitro
datasets.title: In vitro nucleosome occupancy on purified yeast genomic DNA (the positive control task)
datasets.citation: Kaplan N et al., Nature 458:362-366 (2009). doi:10.1038/nature07667
datasets.license: No explicit license on GSE13622; Crossref shows CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 TDM terms on the article.
datasets.genome_build: May 2006 SGD build, between sacCer1 and sacCer2; treat as sacCer2-equivalent and lift to sacCer3 if needed
datasets.columns: Chromosome, Position, Normalized_Nucleosome_Occupancy; one row per covered base pair
datasets.value_note: log2(per-bp coverage / genome mean), mean-subtracted, so 0 is genome average and +1 is twice average. 10,774,972 rows covering 88.6 percent of the nuclear genome. Chromosomes are Arabic 1-16 in Roman order; positions are 1-based.
datasets.why_this_one: Kaplan 2009 and GSE15188 are the only maps assembled on purified bulk genomic DNA. Later in vitro maps use SGD-plasmid libraries and carry library coverage bias, which would corrupt a positive control.
datasets.channel_family: D. Mesoscale mechanics; also the CEILING positive control

datasets.name: cpdseq
datasets.title: CPD-seq UV photoproduct maps at single-nucleotide resolution
datasets.citation: Mao P, Smerdon MJ, Roberts SA, Wyrick JJ. PNAS 113:9057-9062 (2016). doi:10.1073/pnas.1606667113
datasets.license: No permissions block available for the PNAS article; GEO record carries no license statement.
datasets.data_note: variableStep span=1 WIG, 1-based, 17 chromosomes with chr prefix and Roman numerals. The value is per-nucleotide COVERAGE of 2-nt CPD intervals, not a per-dinucleotide count: an isolated YY shows the same number twice, and within a run of positions a,b,c the values are x, x+y, y. Every eligible dipyrimidine is present, with 0.0 where unread, so files are position-aligned and can be divided sample-wise. Both plus and minus files use plus-strand coordinates.
datasets.channel_family: G. Solvation, hydration and chemical reactivity (photochemistry)

datasets.name: dcpdseq
datasets.title: dCPD-seq CPD deamination maps
datasets.citation: Laughery MF, Stark B, Morledge-Hampton B, Roberts SA, Wyrick JJ. Genome Research 36(1):183-196 (2026). doi:10.1101/gr.280384.124
datasets.plan_correction: PLAN.md dates this Genome Research 2025. The GEO release was 2025-10-01 but the paper is 2026.
datasets.data_note: True 1 bp per-lesion resolution: one entry per cytosine in a TC/CT/CC context, 1,786,751 positions per strand. The reported coordinate is the damaged base adjacent to the ligation junction, on the damaged strand.
datasets.channel_family: G. Solvation, hydration and chemical reactivity (photochemistry)

datasets.name: s1_endseq_kasseq
datasets.title: S1-END-seq (DNA secondary structure) and KAS-seq (single-stranded DNA)
datasets.citation: Matos-Rodrigues G et al., S1-END-seq reveals DNA secondary structures in human cells. Molecular Cell 82:3538-3552 (2022). Wu T et al., KAS-seq: genome-wide single-stranded DNA mapping.
datasets.license: No per-dataset license statement in either GEO record.
datasets.genome_build: hg19, determined from the data: the S1-END-seq bigWig chromosome B-tree gives chr1 = 249,250,621, chr2 = 243,199,373 and chrX = 155,270,560 across 25 contigs, and the KAS-seq peak set reaches chr1:249,240,722, which fits hg19 (249,250,621) and overflows hg38 (248,956,422).
datasets.data_note: S1-END-seq GSE203632 ships strand-separated bigWig per sample across five human lines (KM12, SW48, RKO, SW620, SW837); bigWig magic verified as 0x888FFC26 version 4 by range request. KAS-seq GSE139420 ships both bigWig signal and q<0.01 BED peak calls; the BED peaks are the directly usable form.
datasets.verification_note: Located and verified directly after the delegated search did not return them. GSE203632 was confirmed by reading its GEO filelist, which names S1_END_seq files explicitly, rather than by title match.
